sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, AVG("riskmanagement"."compscore") AS m1, AVG(("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m2, (CAST(AVG(("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS REAL) / AVG("riskmanagement"."compscore")) AS m3 FROM "riskmanagement" GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
quantities: riskmanagement.control effectiveness score minus risk score
why: average of compliance posture score per dataflow (by flowlink)
control effectiveness score - risk score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same risk management record
average of control effectiveness score minus risk score per dataflow (by flowlink)
average of control effectiveness score minus risk score relative to average of compliance posture score: both in points, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
